decisions.plan_source_authority: One canonical JSON Plan authoring source owns the meaning-bearing Plan content.
decisions.work_pack_role: WORK-PACK.md is a deterministic coordinator view generated from the canonical JSON Plan source.
decisions.legacy_plan_material: Existing Plan prose that calls WORK-PACK.md the source of truth is migration evidence eligible for supersession, not successor authority.
decisions.distill_contract: Design evidence is pinned to the four public Distill v1 schemas under arcanum/spells/invoke/schemas; concurrent Distill v2 material is outside this boundary.
decisions.design_kind: No admitted Design predecessor exists for this exact target, so W1 proceeds as greenfield Design.
decisions.evidence_closure: Every file discovered by the approved boundary must be cataloged, assigned an applicability owner, and used or explicitly classified before Design selection.

claim_ceiling: This decision resolves W1 input meaning and conflict ownership only. It does not admit a Design, accept a Plan, authorize implementation, or mutate product code.
